BL-1629 — bl968StepRegistryMaterializedTreeGuard.test.js can never come under the 7000 ms per-file budget: its two full step-registry loads are the point of the test (BL-968 invariant 1) and one load costs 12.6 s of require time across 1189 handlers today, yet BL-1598's pole register knows only rows that name an OPEN ticket and read unowned the day it closes; the register gains a disposition column - owned (default) or accepted, an accepted row carrying its rationale and a re-measure date instead of an owner, reported and never refused as new-pole, stale or unowned - and bl968's row is the first accepted one; its blind temp-dir sweep takes BL-1623's helper in the same parcel
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: an accepted row is never silent - the verdict prints it every run with its rationale and re-measure date, so a pole cannot be accepted and forgotten. …
BL-1629 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1629" (or "reject BL-1629 <reason>") to act.
